title: Little Diyas Shine | Manipuri Kids Song, Diwali Rhymes, Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A cheerful Manipuri rhyme about little diyas lighting up the house on Diwali night.
It teaches children to stay safe with sparklers, holding them far away and standing back.
Sing along with the whole family and enjoy the happy glow!
